title: Indian Farmers’ Coalition Plans Nationwide Protests for November 26

ai.summary: The Indian Farmers' Coalition (SKM) plans nationwide protests on November 26, marking six years since the 2020 farm law protests began, demanding a legal minimum support price, farm loan waivers, and other agricultural reforms.

facts.claim: The Samyukta Kisan Morcha (SKM) has called for nationwide demonstrations on November 26
facts.quote: The Samyukta Kisan Morcha (SKM), the coalition that led India’s year-long farm law protests in 2020 and 2021, has called for nationwide demonstrations on November 26, deciding at a national convention in Karnal, Haryana, on October 12 to hold what it described as massive protests in New Delhi and across the country.

facts.claim: November 26 marks six years since farmer unions began their encampment at the borders of the national capital in 2020
facts.quote: November 26 marks six years since farmer unions began their encampment at the borders of the national capital in 2020, a protest that lasted more than a year before the federal government repealed three contested farm laws.

facts.claim: The SKM is demanding a law that would guarantee a minimum support price (MSP) at a rate of input cost plus 50 percent
facts.quote: The coalition is also demanding a law that would guarantee a minimum support price (MSP), the floor price the government sets for farmers’ produce, at a rate of input cost plus 50 percent, with government procurement extended to cover all crops rather than the limited set currently purchased.

facts.claim: The SKM is demanding a comprehensive waiver of farm loans and compensation of Rs 25 lakh for the families of farmers who have died by suicide
facts.quote: Further demands include a comprehensive waiver of farm loans and compensation of Rs 25 lakh for the families of farmers who have died by suicide.

ai.background_note: The SKM, formed in 2020 to oppose the three farm laws, has been active since their repeal in late 2021 and is now pushing for a legal MSP guarantee and other agricultural reforms.
